newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Samsung Display mulls monitor tube cuts.
newsitem.headline: Samsung Display mulls monitor tube cuts.

text.p: Samsung Display Devices Co, the world's largest colour picture tube maker, is considering cutting production of colour display tubes (CDTs) for computer monitors, a company official said on Tuesday.
"We are considering cutting production by around 10-15 percent," said a senior official in the company's public relations department.
He said the company was considering the cuts as a response to a drop in global prices for CDTs, which fell by an average of $10 from last year.
The official declined to give price levels for CDTs, but according to local media reports, the 15-inch CDTs have dropped from around an average of $120-$130 last year to around $110 currently.
The Samsung official said the cuts, if accepted, would be instituted within a month at the earliest.
